newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says economy did not need kick along.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says economy did not need kick along.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the 0.5 percentage point cut in official interest rates to 6.5 percent did not mean the economy needed a kick along.
Asked by reporters if the rate cut meant the Australian economy needed a kick along, he said: "No".
The Reserve Bank of Australia said on Wednesday that it would cut official interest rates by 0.5 percentage points to 6.5 percent.
Rates were last cut on July 31 when the official cash rate was brought down to 7.0 percent from 7.5 percent.

The Reserve Bank said the decision to cut rates was taken by the Reserve Bank board on Tuesday in view of the improvement in the outlook for inflation, which had increased the scope for the economy to sustain a faster rate of growth.
